set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces [interface_name].explanation: The command configures a specific network interface (`[interface_name]`) in Junos, allowing you to set various parameters like IP address, MTU, or VLAN tagging on that interface.

parameters.name: interface_name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be configured

unit [unit_number] family [family_type].explanation: Configure an interface with a specific unit, family type, and IP address

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.explanation: The unit number for the interface configuration

parameters.name: family_type
parameters.explanation: The family type for the interface configuration (e.g., inet)

parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask for the interface
